name: rows are marked one at a time and as a range, a verb takes every one marked and lets them go, and the archived are shown and hidden
about: Run by both consoles, each pressing its own binding for each step: cli/internal/tui/parity_test.go and desktop/src/parity_tests.rs. Each step is a registry command or gesture ID (cli/internal/console/commands.go), pressed with the list's keys and the cursor on its first row; expect is what the list looks like after it: how many boxes a command would act on (targets), how many rows are marked (selected), and whether the archived are listed.
